targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_keys FROM serving.api_keys WHERE status = 'active'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(request_count), 0) AS total_requests FROM serving.api_usage WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 100 ELSE ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) END AS success_pct FROM serving.api_usage WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(response_time_ms)), 0) AS avg_ms FROM serving.api_usage WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AND response_time_ms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time_ms)::numeric), 0) AS p95_ms FROM serving.api_usage WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AND response_time_ms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS error_count FROM serving.api_usage WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AND status_code >= 400

SELECT k.key_id AS "Key ID", k.name AS "名称", k.tier AS "等级", k.status AS "状态", CASE WHEN k.daily_quota IS NULL OR k.daily_quota = 0 THEN 'unlimited' ELSE k.daily_quota::text END AS "日配额", COALESCE(SUM(u.request_count), 0) AS "今日用量", CASE WHEN k.daily_quota IS NULL OR k.daily_quota = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(u.request_count), 0) / k.daily_quota, 1) END AS "配额使用%", TO_CHAR(k.last_used_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "最后使用" FROM serving.api_keys k LEFT JOIN serving.api_usage u ON k.key_id = u.key_id AND (u.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date GROUP BY k.key_id, k.name, k.tier, k.status, k.daily_quota, k.last_used_at ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(u.request_count), 0) DESC

SELECT endpoint AS "Endpoint", COUNT(*) AS "请求数", SUM(CASE WHEN status_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "成功", SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "错误", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(response_time_ms)), 0) AS "平均耗时ms", COALESCE(ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time_ms)::numeric), 0) AS "P50ms", COALESCE(ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time_ms)::numeric), 0) AS "P95ms", MAX(response_time_ms) AS "最大耗时ms" FROM serving.api_usage WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT (date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time, SUM(request_count) AS total_requests FROM serving.api_usage WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - INTERVAL '29 days') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN request_count ELSE 0 END) AS error_requests FROM serving.api_usage WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - INTERVAL '29 days') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time, ROUND(AVG(response_time_ms)) AS avg_all_ms FROM serving.api_usage WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - INTERVAL '29 days') AND response_time_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT (date_trunc('day', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time, ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY response_time_ms)::numeric) AS p95_all_ms FROM serving.api_usage WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - INTERVAL '29 days') AND response_time_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 按 Key 的每日用量

targets.rawSql: SELECT (date_trunc('day', u.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS time, k.name AS metric, SUM(u.request_count) AS requests FROM serving.api_usage u JOIN serving.api_keys k ON k.key_id = u.key_id WHERE (u.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - INTERVAL '29 days') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT status_code::text AS status_code, COUNT(*) AS count FROM serving.api_usage WHERE (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date >= ((NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date - INTERVAL '6 days') GROUP BY status_code ORDER BY count DESC
